clips.text: I'm Dead John, coming to you LIVE, and this... is DEAD AIR.
Seventeen fourteen on your A M dial. I'm Dead John, coming to you LIVE, and this... is DEAD AIR.
If you can hear this, you found us. I'm Dead John, coming to you LIVE, and this... is DEAD AIR.
DEAD AIR. Seventeen fourteen A M. Past the end of the dial.
You're tuned to seventeen fourteen. No license. No sign off. No problem.
This is DEAD AIR. The station that never learned how to stop.
Seventeen fourteen A M. If you can hear me, you're closer than you think.
Radio's dead. Turn it up anyway. This is DEAD AIR.
Top of the hour on DEAD AIR. Nobody's coming to fix the signal, so let's keep going.
Another hour on the graveyard shift. I'm Dead John. I'm not going anywhere. I tried.
If you're driving, keep your eyes on the road. If you're not driving... keep your eyes on the window.
It's fourteen past three. It's always fourteen past three somewhere. Usually here.
It's late. It's been late for a long time.
Marty, you there? ...Marty's not there. Marty's never there.
Marty says the transmitter's fine. I haven't heard from Marty since the storm, but I believe him.
Coffee's cold. Coffee's been cold since the night of the storm. Still drinking it.
Weather for the overnight. Fog rolling in off nothing. Low of never. Bring a coat anyway.
Forecast says static, with a chance of somebody calling your name. Don't answer.
Clear skies tonight. You can see every star. Some of them went out a long time ago. Same as me.
The request line is open. Tell me who it's for. I'll read it on the air. The dead are great listeners.
Got a call on the request line. Let me read this one just like they wrote it.
That one's for you. Wherever you are tonight.
DEAD AIR is brought to you by Hollow Pines Motor Lodge. Vacancy. Always vacancy.
This hour brought to you by Orpheum Drive In. Tonight's double feature starts the minute you stop looking for it.
Brought to you by Gable's Twenty Four Hour Diner. The lights are on. Nobody remembers turning them on.
Stay close. Something you haven't heard in a while is coming up next.
Don't touch that dial. You couldn't if you tried.
That was NoBanks Nearby, right here on seventeen fourteen.
It's midnight. I have to step away from the microphone for a few minutes. Whatever you hear next... it isn't me. Don't write it down.
I'm back. Did you write it down? ...I told you not to write it down.
That was only a test. I think. Nobody tells me anything anymore.
This is usually where a DJ signs off. I tried that once. It didn't take. Stay with me.
The night the tower went down, I was right in the middle of a sentence. Some nights I think I'm still finishing it.
